%3A%22Jim%20Beam%22%7D%2C%22is_enriched%22%3Atrue%2C%22brand_action%22%3Anull%2C%22rich_properties%22%3Anull%7D%2C%7B%22id%22%3A%2261952ddb73ec4e49d509004c%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Maker's%20Mark%20Bourbon%20Whisky%22%2C%22basic_category%22%3A%5B%22bourbon%22%2C%22whiskey%22%5D%2C%22description%22%3A%22If%20you're%20looking%20for%20a%20smooth%2C%20sweet%20and%20easy-to-drink%20whisky%2C%20you've%20found%20it.%20Maker's%20Mark%20Classic%20Bourbon%20was%20carefully%20developed%20by%20sixth-generation%20distiller%20Bill%20Samuels%20Sr.%20to%20be%20just%20that.%20Still%20made%20to%20his%20unique%20recipe%2C%20this%20full-flavored%20bourbon%20is%20subtly%20woody%20with%20flavors%20of%20vanilla%2C%20caramel%20and%20fruit.%20It's%20easy%20to%20drink%20neat%2C%20and%20can%20pull%20its%20weight%20in%20a%20cocktail.%20Mix%20it%20with%20ginger%20ale%20and%20lime%20for%20an%20effortless%20long%20drink.%20This%20one%20literally%20changed%20the%20way%20we%20think%20about%20bourbon%2C%20all%20because%20one%20man%20changed%20the%20way%20he%20thought%20about%20making%20it.%20Bill%20Samuels%2C%20Sr.%2C%20wanted%20a%20whisky%20he%20would%20enjoy%20drinking.%20Never%20bitter%20or%20sharp%2C%20Maker's%20Mark%20is%20made%20with%20soft%20red%20winter%20wheat%2C%20instead%20of%20rye%2C%20for%20a%20one-of-a-kind%2C%20full-flavored%20bourbon%20that's%20approachably%20smooth.%20To%20ensure%20consistency%2C%20we%20still%20rotate%20every%20barrel%20by%20hand%20and%20age%20our%20bourbon%20to%20taste%2C%20not%20time.%20Just%20like%20Bill%20would%20have%20wanted.%20Once%20it's%20ready%20it's%20bottled%20at%2090%20proof%2C%20hand-dipped%20in%20our%20signature%20red%20wax.%20Just%20think%20of%20it%20as%20our%20seal%20of%20approval.%20Since%20its%20establishment%2C%20Maker's%20Mark%20has%20continually%20impressed%20critics%2C%20winning%20double%20gold%20at%20the%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20in%202020%20and%202021.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https% 2%2C%22option_display_data%22%3A%7B%22name%22%3A%22Maker's%20Mark%20Bourbon%20Whisky%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22If%20you're%20looking%20for%20a%20smooth%2C%20sweet%20and%20easy-to-drink%20whisky%2C%20you've%20found%20it.%20Maker's%20Mark%20Classic%20Bourbon%20was%20carefully%20developed%20by%20sixth-generation%20distiller%20Bill%20Samuels%20Sr.%20to%20be%20just%20that.%20Still%20made%20to%20his%20unique%20recipe%2C%20this%20full-flavored%20bourbon%20is%20subtly%20woody%20with%20flavors%20of%20vanilla%2C%20caramel%20and%20fruit.%20It's%20easy%20to%20drink%20neat%2C%20and%20can%20pull%20its%20weight%20in%20a%20cocktail.%20Mix%20it%20with%20ginger%20ale%20and%20lime%20for%20an%20effortless%20long%20drink.%20This%20one%20literally%20changed%20the%20way%20we%20think%20about%20bourbon%2C%20all%20because%20one%20man%20changed%20the%20way%20he%20thought%20about%20making%20it.%20Bill%20Samuels%2C%20Sr.%2C%20wanted%20a%20whisky%20he%20would%20enjoy%20drinking.%20Never%20bitter%20or%20sharp%2C%20Maker's%20Mark%20is%20made%20with%20soft%20red%20winter%20wheat%2C%20instead%20of%20rye%2C%20for%20a%20one-of-a-kind%2C%20full-flavored%20bourbon%20that's%20approachably%20smooth.%20To%20ensure%20consistency%2C%20we%20still%20rotate%20every%20barrel%20by%20hand%20and%20age%20our%20bourbon%20to%20taste%2C%20not%20time.%20Just%20like%20Bill%20would%20have%20wanted.%20Once%20it's%20ready%20it's%20bottled%20at%2090%20proof%2C%20hand-dipped%20in%20our%20signature%20red%20wax.%20Just%20think%20of%20it%20as%20our%20seal%20of%20approval.%20Since%20its%20establishment%2C%20Maker's%20Mark%20has%20continually%20impressed%20critics%2C%20winning%20double%20gold%20at%20the%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20in%202020%20and%202021.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F68e7ec900208f626de282cd8%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F68e7ec900 C%20caramel%20and%20fruit.%20It's%20easy%20to%20drink%20neat%2C%20and%20can%20pull%20its%20weight%20in%20a%20cocktail.%20Mix%20it%20with%20ginger%20ale%20and%20lime%20for%20an%20effortless%20long%20drink.%20This%20one%20literally%20changed%20the%20way%20we%20think%20about%20bourbon%2C%20all%20because%20one%20man%20changed%20the%20way%20he%20thought%20about%20making%20it.%20Bill%20Samuels%2C%20Sr.%2C%20wanted%20a%20whisky%20he%20would%20enjoy%20drinking.%20Never%20bitter%20or%20sharp%2C%20Maker's%20Mark%20is%20made%20with%20soft%20red%20winter%20wheat%2C%20instead%20of%20rye%2C%20for%20a%20one-of-a-kind%2C%20full-flavored%20bourbon%20that's%20approachably%20smooth.%20To%20ensure%20consistency%2C%20we%20still%20rotate%20every%20barrel%20by%20hand%20and%20age%20our%20bourbon%20to%20taste%2C%20not%20time.%20Just%20like%20Bill%20would%20have%20wanted.%20Once%20it's%20ready%20it's%20bottled%20at%2090%20proof%2C%20hand-dipped%20in%20our%20signature%20red%20wax.%20Just%20think%20of%20it%20as%20our%20seal%20of%20approval.%20Since%20its%20establishment%2C%20Maker's%20Mark%20has%20continually%20impressed%20critics%2C%20winning%20double%20gold%20at%20the%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20in%202020%20and%202021.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F66ec77ee1ded282b5ea02d57%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F66ec77ee1ded282b5ea02d57%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F66ec77ee1ded282b5ea02d57%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F66ec77ee1ded282b5ea02d57%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F66ec77ee1ded282b5ea02d57%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%5D%7D%2C%22size%22%3A%7B%22measure%22%3A%22ml%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A%22750%22%7D%2C%22s A%22%2C%22content%22%3A%2245.2%25%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22United%20States%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22Kentucky%22%2C%22region%22%3A%22Versailles%22%2C%22basic_category%22%3A%22Spirits%22%2C%22brands%22%3A%22Woodford%20Reserve%22%7D%2C%22is_enriched%22%3Atrue%2C%22brand_action%22%3Anull%2C%22rich_properties%22%3Anull%7D%2C%7B%22id%22%3A%2259d756b62c4a912712fec81f%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Woodford%20Reserve%20Kentucky%20Straight%20Bourbon%20Whiskey%22%2C%22basic_category%22%3A%5B%22bourbon%22%2C%22whiskey%22%5D%2C%22description%22%3A%22%3Cp%3EIn%20preparation%20for%20the%20upcoming%20holiday%20season%2C%20Woodford%20Reserve%20has%20debuted%20its%20annual%20holiday%20bourbon%20bottle.%20%3C%2Fp%3E%3Cp%3E%5Cr%5Cn%5Cr%5CnThe%20bottle%20has%20white%20raised%20texture%20evoking%20snow%2C%20and%20smooth%20glossy%20gold%20foil%20that%20%E2%80%9Ccompliments%20the%20rich%20color%20of%20the%20bourbon%2C%E2%80%9D%20the%20company%20says.%3C%2Fp%3E%3Cp%3E%5Cr%5Cn%5Cr%5Cn%E2%80%9CA%20Woodford%20Reserve%20holiday%20bottle%20is%20the%20perfect%20gift%20this%20season%2C%20and%20it%20will%20make%20a%20beautiful%20addition%20to%20any%20bar%20cart%2C%E2%80%9D%20says%20Woodford%20Reserve%20Master%20Distiller%20Elizabeth%20McCall.%20%E2%80%9CIt%E2%80%99s%20the%20perfect%20gift%20to%20bring%20to%20a%20holiday%20party%20%E2%80%93%20or%20even%20a%20treat%20to%20yourself.%E2%80%9D%3C%2Fp%3E%3Cp%3EWoodford%20Reserve%20bourbon%20is%20made%20from%20a%20combination%20of%20pot%20still%20and%20column%20still%20whiskey.%20It's%20aged%20between%206-7%20years%20and%20bottled%20at%2045.2%25%20ABV.%3C%2Fp%3E%3Cp%3EWoodford%20Reserve%20Kentucky%20Straight%20Bourbon%20Whiskey%20offers%20a%20perfectly%20balanced%20taste%20with%20more%20than%20200%20detectable%20flavor%20notes.%20Craft%20mixed%20drinks%20like%20a%20Mint%20Julep%20or%20Old%20Fashioned%20with%20this%20bourbon%20whiskey.%20Each%20bourbon%20barrel%20helps%20Woodford%20Reserve%20deliver%20a%20heavy%20aroma%20of%20rich%20dried%20fruit%20with%20a%20smooth%2C%20satisfying%20finish.%20Crafted%20Carefully.%20Drink%20Responsibly.%3C%2Fp%3E%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F6535238dc6f9481ad66fb748%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F6535238dc6f9481ad66fb748%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F6535238dc6f9481ad66fb748%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F6535238dc6f9481ad66fb748%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F6535238dc6f9481ad66fb748%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%5D%7D%2C%22size%22%3A%7B%22measure%22%3A%22L%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A%221%22%7D%2C%22tags%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22views%22%3A%5B%22alcohol%22%2C%22spirits%22%5D%2C%22customer_favorite%22%3Afalse%2C%22is_taxed%22%3Atrue%2C%22options%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22merchants%22%3A%5B%7B%22offer_types%22%3A%5B%22pick_up%22%2C%22delivery%22%2C%22shipping%22%5D%2C%22product_options%22%3A%5B%7B%22product_id%22%3A%2256c28bc7756275139d9f0100%22%2C%22option_id%22%3A%22e572faa99b10592679561189d8bcc813aaff608eb9c2e0cc08b41db7f5335f1a%22%2C%22option_params%22%3A%7B%22size%22%3A%7B%22measure%22%3A%22ml%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A%22375%22%7D%7D%2C%22product_url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcedartownliquor.com%2Fshop%2Fproduct%2Fwoodford-reserve-kentucky-straight-bourbon-whiskey%2F56c28bc7756275139d9f0100%3Foption-id%3De572faa99b10592679561189d8bcc813aaff608eb9c2e0cc08b41db7f5335f1a%22%2C%22product_url_path%22%3A%22%2Fproduct%2Fwoodford-reserve-kentucky-straight-bourbon-whiskey%2F56c28bc7756275139d9f0100%3Foption-id%3De572faa99b10592679561189d8bcc813aaff608eb9c2e0cc08b41db7f5335f1a%22%2C%22original_option_params%22%3A%7B%22size%22%3A%7B%22measure%22%3A%22ml%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A%22375%22%7D%7D%2C%22stock_components%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22units_of_measure%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22badge%2 s%20smooth%2C%20rich%20and%20easy%20to%20enjoy.%20Evan%20Williams%20is%20medium%20amber%20in%20color%20and%20has%20aromas%20of%20vanilla%20and%20mint%20with%20a%20taste%20of%20oak%2C%20brown%20sugar%2C%20and%20caramel.%20Evan%20Williams%20is%20the%20%232%20selling%20Kentucky%20Straight%20Bourbon%20brand%20in%20the%20world.%20A%202024%20SIP%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20and%20Consumers'%20Choice%20winner%2C%20a%20TAG%20Global%20Spirits%20Awards%20Double%20Gold%20winner%2C%20and%20a%20San%20Francisco%20World%20Spirits%20Competition%20Double%20Gold%20winner.%22%2C%22images%22%3A%7B%22primary%22%3A%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef928d7fe234e28154a40%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-production-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef928d7fe234e28154a40%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef928d7fe234e28154a40%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef928d7fe234e28154a40%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef928d7fe234e28154a40%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%22more_images%22%3A%5B%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef974d1719d2b496081fe%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef974d1719d2b496081fe%2Flarge.png%22%2C%22medium%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef974d1719d2b496081fe%2Fmedium.png%22%2C%22small%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef974d1719d2b496081fe%2Fsmall.png%22%2C%22thumbnail%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef974d1719d2b496081fe%2Fthumbnail.png%22%7D%2C%7B%22original%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcityhive-prod-cdn.cityhive.net%2Fproducts%2F686ef980d1719d2b496081ff%2Foriginal.png%22%2C%22large%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fci
